title: QA swarm: put the part briefs in qa/briefs/ with a README for runs and reports

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:low
labels.description: Mechanical, one file, no new logic (issue-worker-low)

body:
## The maintainer's words

Maintainer decision on #2582, 2026-11-22: "Exploratory agent runs stay on contributors' own machines and never in GitHub Actions. They are tracked on one pinned issue with one comment per run. The part briefs go in `qa/briefs/` in the repository. Each issue that a run files gets a `source:qa` label."

## What exists

- The briefs are only on the host of the QA swarm: `~/qa/briefs/q0*.md`. The job script is `~/qa/bin/qa-job.sh` (comment of 2026-11-20 on #2582).
- The umbrella #2582 names the earlier parts p01 to p10: flange, bracket, stepped block, threaded boss, wrapped cylinder, all-ops mill part, lathe shaft, microARC 4 part, turning on a mill, plasma plate.
- The run of 2026-11-20 used the briefs q01 (2D plate), q02 (3D mould core) and q03 (turned pin).
- The repository has no `qa/` folder.

## Necessary work

1. Make the folder `qa/briefs/`.
2. Add one brief file for each part family: mill 3-axis (2D and 3D), mill multi-axis, turning, plasma and wire. Put each part (p01 to p10, q01 to q03) into the file of its family. Keep the text of each brief that exists. Change only what names a host path or a person.
3. Add one brief for each agent role that a run uses, if the role differs from the part brief (for example the job that designs the part in SolidCraft and the job that makes it in CamCraft).
4. Write `qa/README.md`. It says:
   - how a run starts (the tools, the versions to test, the order of steps), with no secret and no host name;
   - that a run is on a contributor's own machine, never in GitHub Actions;
   - where the report goes: one comment for each run on the pinned tracking issue (see the tracking issue linked from #2582);
   - that each issue that a run files gets `source:qa`;
   - when to run: after each minor cut tag, after each SolidCraft release (at most daily), and on demand.
5. Put no model file, no project file and no run output in `qa/`. Only text files.

## Done means

- `qa/briefs/` has one brief file for each family and each role, and `qa/README.md` exists.
- Each part p01 to p10 and q01 to q03 is in a brief.
- No file in `qa/` has a secret, a key, a host name or a home path.
- The PR is docs only. It needs no `Changelog:` row.

Refs #2582
